topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: Oh my gosh, I can't believe this happened! I was driving by and saw your place, and then I noticed your car was gone. I mean, I totally thought it was just parked somewhere else, but then I saw the note on your door. That's just so messed up, I mean, how can they do that? I should've known it was trouble. I passed by earlier and saw a tow truck, but I didn’t think... I wish I could've called you right then. I'm here for you, and we'll figure this out. They can't just tow from your own driveway, right? Let's go and sort this out, okay?
